purpose: A registry-only blueprint for Din Allah Encyclopedia scientific-religious video synthesis. It generates original documentary videos from evidence, licensed media, and synthetic scenes without changing canonical scholarly content or runtime dependencies.

evidencePolicy.promotionRule: Never convert an interpretive link into a scientific fact or an Islamic doctrine claim automatically.
evidencePolicy.sourceTraceability: Every factual claim must point to one or more evidence records before entering the final timeline.

quranAndHadith.quranTextSourcePolicy: Use a verified canonical Quran text source and preserve Arabic text verbatim.
quranAndHadith.translationPolicy: Treat translations of meanings as separate copyrighted/licensed assets and label them as meanings/translations, never as the Arabic Quran text.
quranAndHadith.hadithPolicy: Attach collection, reference, grading/status, and scholarly source metadata before presentation.
quranAndHadith.wordHighlighting: Use word-level alignment only after a rights-cleared recitation is selected.

question_understanding.role: Turn the browser question into explicit sub-questions, claims, visual concepts and evidence needs.

islamic_evidence.role: Retrieve Quran, tafsir, authenticated hadith and scholarly explanations without altering canonical text.

scientific_evidence.role: Retrieve primary literature, institutional sources, datasets and authoritative scientific references.

claim_verification.role: Classify evidence strength and block unsupported miracle/health claims.

evidence_graph.role: Link claim -> source -> quote/observation -> verse/hadith -> scene.

global_media_discovery.role: Find reusable media by explicit license/permission and provenance; non-cleared media remains reference-only.

original_scene_generation.role: Generate new scientific or explanatory visuals when no suitable cleared footage exists.

semantic_scene_composer.role: Map every claim to visual evidence, overlays, references and timing.

scene_analysis.role: Detect cuts, shots, motion and usable segments for lawful source material.

quran_word_alignment.role: Align a rights-cleared recitation to Quran words/characters for synchronized highlighting.

multilingual_translation.role: Render approved translations/subtitles in the browser language while preserving source metadata.

voice_engine.role: Manage narration/recitation assets and licensing; cloning is blocked unless explicit rights are recorded.

timeline_composer.role: Create a deterministic edit timeline that can be re-rendered when evidence changes.

documentary_director.role: Select pedagogical order, pacing, transitions and conclusion without changing evidence strength.

provenance_manifest.role: Persist source, license, checksum, model, version and timing metadata for every asset.

render_engine.role: Render masters and delivery variants up to the configured 48K-class ceiling.

rendering_and_transcode.name: FFmpeg
rendering_and_transcode.softwareLicense: LGPL/GPL depending on build and enabled components

outputPolicy.importantConstraint: 48K is an output/render ceiling, not a claim that every generation model produces native 48K frames.
outputPolicy.qualityRequirement: Upscaling may not invent or alter Quran text, hadith text, scientific labels, citations, or factual diagrams; text-bearing layers must be rendered from source vectors at final resolution.

assetPolicy.referenceOnlyMeans: A discovered third-party video may inform research but cannot be embedded, redistributed or transformed unless the rights gate permits it.
